title: Explicit String Vacua and the Geometric Selection Conjecture
description: Release 3.0.0 of the paper by Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya, with its LaTeX source and the programs that check its finite arithmetic. The paper computes the character labels, cubic couplings and mass maps of the Dwork and weighted Fermat pencils, proves that the mirror clause of the Geometric Selection Conjecture is empty, constructs one explicit heterotic datum on a free quotient of a tetraquadric and audits it against the nine conditions. New in this version: on every Calabi-Yau threefold with at most four Kahler parameters every polystable sum of five line bundles with vanishing first Chern class keeps an Abelian gauge boson massless at its split locus, the polystable classes of the fixed bundle form the volume ray, and the perturbative selection rules exclude six of eleven split data on the tetraquadric. The Geometric Selection Conjecture is not proved.
